image_location_description: Bottom of model, directly under both feet (not shown in reference).

steps.title: Reinforce layer
steps.description: Add 1x Plate 4x8 (3035) DarkBluishGray on top, aligned.

steps.title: Fill width
steps.description: Add 1x Plate 2x8 (3034) LightBluishGray beside it to make 6x8.

steps.title: Top surface start
steps.description: Add 1x Plate 2x8 (3034) LightBluishGray on top along one side.

steps.title: Top surface fill 1
steps.description: Add 2x Plate 1x4 (3710) LightBluishGray to fill the center.

steps.title: Top surface fill 2
steps.description: Add 2x Plate 1x4 (3710) LightBluishGray to complete 6x8 top.

steps.title: Front edge tiles
steps.description: Add 2x Tile 1x4 (2431) LightBluishGray along the front edge.

steps.title: Back edge tiles
steps.description: Add 2x Tile 1x4 (2431) LightBluishGray along the back edge.

steps.title: Left edge tiles
steps.description: Add 3x Tile 1x2 Grille (2412b) Black down the left edge.

steps.title: Right edge tiles
steps.description: Add 3x Tile 1x2 Grille (2412b) Black down the right edge.

steps.title: Foot pads
steps.description: Add 2x Plate 2x2 (3022) Black where the feet will stand.

steps.title: Underside feet
steps.description: Flip base; add 4x Plate 1x2 (3023) DarkBluishGray near corners.

steps.title: Underside stiffeners
steps.description: Add 2x Plate 1x2 (3703) Black under the center line.

steps.title: Underside centering
steps.description: Add 2x Plate 1x2 (3023) LightBluishGray under remaining gaps.
